rows.name: Scrap magnet
rows.desc: Each pile tap also pulls in this share of what your pile crew digs per second.

rows.name: Lighter work
rows.desc: Stations need less work per part, so taps and crews fill the bars sooner.

rows.name: Crew per station
rows.desc: Each station makes room for one more worker in its line's crew.

rows.name: Faster crews
rows.desc: Every worker, on the lines and the pile, works more often.

rows.name: Harder hits
rows.desc: Each field tap hits the wave for this share of your mechs' damage per second.

rows.name: Pile crew size
rows.desc: Room for one more worker on the pile.

rows.name: Bigger shovels
rows.desc: Pile workers dig up more scrap per trip.

rows.name: Pay raises
rows.desc: Mechs on the field get a x1.5 pay raise every few seconds they survive, up to this cap.

rows.name: Faster raises
rows.desc: Mechs on the field get their pay raises sooner.

rows.name: Higher fees
rows.desc: Every mech pays a bigger fee when it leaves the line.

rows.name: Salvage
rows.desc: Wrecked mechs give back part of their scrap.

rows.name: Cheaper parts
rows.desc: Every part on every line costs less scrap.

rows.name: Enemy scrap
rows.desc: Each destroyed enemy drops scrap. Tougher enemies drop more.

rows.name: New line
rows.desc: Another assembly line with its own stations and crew.
